repositoryPathsSearched: art/ and public/ (find, for any icon or SVG asset)
found: No icon set exists. A find across art/ and public/ returns only pose control plates and arm-measurement QA overlays, both authoring evidence. The interface uses text and font glyphs throughout.
shortfall: The set of things that need an icon is closed and known — ShellRef is exactly five kinds — and none of them has one. Drive was not searched, for the same reason as above.
generationRecipe: Five icons, one for each ShellRef kind: person, commitment, measure, government, organization.

Government and organization must stay distinguishable at icon size. The navigation code is explicit that a place and the government of that place are different things and that blurring them starts implying where the player lives.
A commitment is a scheduled activity in the player's own calendar. It should not read as a debt or a promise to somebody.
One consistent weight and construction across all five, legible in a dense rail, and readable on both light and dark surfaces.
No party emblems, no donkey or elephant, no real government seal.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly five, matching the five ShellRef kinds by name.
Government and organization are tellable apart at the size the pin rail actually uses.
All five read as one set: same weight, same construction, same optical size.
Legible against both a light and a dark surface without a second version.
Carries no party emblem and no real government's seal.

target.styleAuthority: None yet — this set will become the style authority for every icon added after it, so its construction rules matter more than any single glyph.
